name: Junket
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: cream or fruit syrup for serving
ingredients.originalText: cream or fruit syrup for serving

instructions.text: Put the junket tablet to soak in the cold water
Heat the sugar and milk to blood heat, but no hotter
Crush and dissolve the tablet in the water
Stir the whole into the milk
Pour at once into the serving dish
Let stand in a warm room until it sets
Move carefully to a cold place to chill before serving with cream or fruit syrup

source.originalInstructions:
1. Put the junket tablet to soak in the cold water
2. Heat the sugar and milk to blood heat, but no hotter
3. Crush and dissolve the tablet in the water
4. Stir the whole into the milk
5. Pour at once into the serving dish
6. Let stand in a warm room until it sets
7. Move carefully to a cold place to chill before serving with cream or fruit syrup
